comparison.objective: Candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-2108 aligns a flaring yoke and forms a copper-tube flare.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use rotational hand tools, but the candidate couples a driver and thin-nut wrench to preserve an adjustment; PR-2108 sets tube height/yoke alignment, clamps, advances a forming cone through clutch release, and retracts it.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained 90° opening after repeated actuation; PR-2108 requires a geometrically good, sufficiently ironed flare with the cone retracted and hands clear.
comparison.reason: PR-2108 tests irreversible alignment-dependent forming, not locknut counterholding or post-lock functional retention.
